# Meyn AI - LLMs.txt

## About
Meyn AI is building PromptOps, a platform that orchestrates AI coding agents with structured specs, real-time feature tracking, and visual spec-to-code traceability.

## Website
https://meyn.work/

## Main Pages
- Homepage: https://meyn.work/
- Manifesto: https://meyn.work/manifesto.html
- Investors: https://meyn.work/investors.html

## Product
PromptOps platform for vibe coders - A platform that orchestrates your AI coding agents with structured specs, real-time tracking, and visual traceability.

## Key Features
- Structured specs for AI coding agents
- Real-time feature tracking
- Visual spec-to-code traceability
- Automated drift detection
- Version history and traceability
- Spec quality gates
- Retroactive spec creation

## Contact
Website: https://meyn.work/
Waitlist: Available on homepage

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML, CSS (Tailwind CSS), JavaScript
- Backend: Vercel Serverless Functions
- Data Storage: Google Sheets API
- Hosting: Vercel
